description: Live weather for any city or coordinates: current conditions, the next 24 hours, a 7-day forecast, or active severe-weather alerts (US). From the US National Weather Service and MET Norway. Use it when: A task depends on the weather: planning travel, events, outdoor work, deliveries or a shoot, or checking for storms and warnings. Not for: Historical weather, climate statistics, or alerts outside the US. Returns: Depends on the action; see the actions table. Every answer names its source and attribution. Typical time: about 2 s. Actions: current (conditions right now; needs nothing); hourly (the next 24 hours, hour by hour; needs nothing); 7_day (the week ahead; needs nothing); alerts (active severe-weather alerts (us only); needs nothing). Price: from $0.002 per lookup, charged only on success. Price depends on action: 7_day $0.002, alerts $0.002, hourly $0.002, current $0.002 (default current). One call = one weather lookup (current, hourly, 7-day or alerts).

action.description: What to get; each has its own price. Default current

lat.description: Latitude, with lon, instead of location

location.description: A city, e.g. 'Austin, TX' or 'Paris, France' (cities of 15,000+ people). Or send lat and lon

lon.description: Longitude, with lat, instead of location
